documents.court: Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware
documents.case_name: David Abraham v. The Estate of W. Rockwell Wirtz, James English, Wirtz Corporation, Consolidated Enterprises, Inc., Forman Realty Company LLC, and American Mart Company LLC
documents.legal_topic: Short-form LLC merger (6 Del. C. Section 18-209(i)); appraisal rights perfection; quasi-appraisal remedy; merger notice disclosure adequacy
documents.selection_rationale: Most recent of the four candidates and a short-form merger (structurally distinct fact pattern from the other three long-form merger appraisals); smallest file, used as the first, fastest end-to-end validation run before larger documents.
documents.notes: Case caption, docket number, and decision date verified by extracting real text directly from the PDF (not from search snippets or prior knowledge). Originally mislabeled '2024' during initial candidate selection before this verification; corrected to 2025 here. Download verified: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, valid PDF 1.7 structure confirmed via `file` command. First ingestion run (20260709T095655Z-4e2139d3, F0 tier) processed only 2 of 34 pages due to the F0 free-tier page cap. After upgrading di-legal-rag-dev to S0, re-run 20260711T201422Z-985b95b6 processed all 34 pages successfully (185 elements, 0 warnings, schema-valid). Re-run 20260711T203821Z-be1f0a11 used the enhanced structure.py heading-style heuristic (max section-hierarchy nesting depth reduced from 10 to 4; two staircase defects flattened into correct sibling groups); a residual cross-branch same-style-name collision and the pre-existing, out-of-scope decimal-absolute-reset behavior remain. See the Phase 1.5 heading-hierarchy engineering report for full detail.
